description: This is a mod that fills Minecraft with uncertainty. Breaking blocks, crafting items, and killing mobs will all result in completely random drops.

mods.name: Random Drop
mods.description: A Fabric mod that randomizes all drops in Minecraft. Break blocks, kill mobs, or craft items — the results are never what you expect.

releases.notes:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/355416wql/Random-drop/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
What's Changed
New Features
In-game config screen — Press R to open the configuration screen and tweak settings without leaving the game
Natural block drop randomization — Random drops now also apply to naturally falling blocks (gravel, sand, etc.) and spreading blocks (fire, etc.)
Improvements
Refactored crafting result randomization from ResultSlot to a more robust Slot mixin
Block drops now respect vanilla drop rules: items only drop when the correct tool is used
Config system now supports saving changes at runtime via the in-game screen
Configuration
New options in config/random-drop.json:

randomNaturalBlockDropsEnabled — Toggle natural block drop randomization
naturalBlockDropBlacklist — Items excluded from natural block drops
